title: corybas pruinosus
intro: Corybas pruinosus, commonly known as the powderpuff orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to Australia. It is a non-toxic and edible plant that has been traditionally used for medicinal purposes. The health benefits of Corybas pruinosus include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects.
